full_judgment: 7. In the aforesaid circumstances the impugned Memorandum of the Ministry of Public Works and Urban Development, Government of the People's Republic of Bangladesh made on 4-7-78 directing the petitioner to hand over the possession of the House No. 19-D, Road No. 6 in the Dhanmondi Residential Area, Dacca at best can be treated as a notice to the petitioner for termination of lease as contemplated u/s. 106 of the Transfer of Property Act. In the event of any failure or refusal to vacate the premises and hand over the possession thereof to the relevant authority of the Government, the only course left in future for the government would be to institute a civil suit before a civil court against the petitioner for termination of the monthly lease and tenancy with regard to the aforesaid House No. 19-D at Road No. 6 in the Dhanmondi Residential Area, Dacca. No authority of the government can evict and eject the petitioner as such from the aforesaid premises otherwise than by a decree of a Civil Court as aforesaid.
